  - [ARG-049](../record/arguments.d/ARG-049.md) — The pauses, averted gaze and reversal in the MSF transcript show internal conflict as a gap between the precedence a motive claims and the authority it is granted *(Rejected, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-486](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-486.md) — A rendering can keep the communicative act while changing the proposition, so preserving the proposition is not necessary for preserving the communicative event *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-020](../record/arguments.d/ARG-020.md) — The compensation hypothesis gives the mechanism by which a rendering keeps the act while changing the proposition *(Rejected, cause-to-effect)*
  - [ARG-021](../record/arguments.d/ARG-021.md) — The manuscript's renderings, which keep the words and change the act, show that keeping the proposition is not necessary for keeping the act *(Rejected, existence)*
- [CLAIM-491](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-491.md) — No action is selfless in the sense of aiming at a good that is no self's: what is called selflessness, collectivist or altruistic, is concern for the good of a self extended to include others or a group, so collectivism is self-interest on a larger self-identity *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-076](../record/arguments.d/ARG-076.md) — Eyerman's cultural trauma and Volkan's chosen trauma are evidence for the owner's thesis only for chosen trauma, where an ancestral injury is taken up as an injury to a present group identity and felt as grievance when that identity is threatened; they do not tell an enlarged self from a switched one, and they leave mourning for particular dead open *(Proposed, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-497](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-497.md) — A system's causes are found at the coarsest description whose interventions are unambiguous: a macro description is causally proportionate where it merges only micro states that intervention cannot tell apart, and no coarse-graining carries more causal information than the micro description it supervenes on *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-041](../record/arguments.d/ARG-041.md) — From the effective-information bound and its ties to proportionality: a gain that depends on the intervention distribution is not a property of the system, the coarse-grainings that lose nothing are, and the coarsest of them is where the causes are *(Proposed, formal-application)*
- [CLAIM-511](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-511.md) — A self-maintaining organization ought to preserve its corrigibility *(Proposed, disclaimed)*
  - [ARG-042](../record/arguments.d/ARG-042.md) — The record's constructions of maintained correction show that self-maintaining organizations ought to preserve their corrigibility *(Rejected, evidence)*
    - [CLAIM-520](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-520.md) — The value of keeping a corrective capacity is conditional on objectives, uncertainty and cost: a free, optional audit cannot lower a single time-consistent decision-maker's expected performance, but an audit that costs C to maintain and bears on k decisions with error rate ε is worth k(0.25 − 0.5ε) − C in the exchange's model, negative when C is large or k small, and where no hypothesis fits the world, correction gains no reward and improves only calibration *(Active, thesis)*
- [CLAIM-518](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-518.md) — Normative judgments about an organization's continuity, reform or obligations can depend on diachronic relations that descriptions of present states or terminal outcomes do not show, so specifying the relevant relations and histories can be necessary to apply them adequately; which continuations ought to follow is a further normative question, not a prerequisite of every normative judgment *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-043](../record/arguments.d/ARG-043.md) — Bencherki's checklist and daycare, one end state with opposite verdicts, show a normative judgment about an organization that depends on a history its end state does not show *(Proposed, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-521](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-521.md) — An organization's present coupling strength need not reveal the stability of the process maintaining it: in a constructed system whose maintained connector and capacities set a three-unit coupling, the recovery rate of the maintenance goes to zero at its saddle-node while the coupling's spectral gap there stays near 0.989 *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-068](../record/arguments.d/ARG-068.md) — A coordination mode held stable by a capacity declining from below its maintenance threshold is an instance of the dissociation between a coupling's strength and the stability of the saddle-node maintaining it *(Rejected, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-522](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-522.md) — Recovery under interventions on state cannot show where maintenance is realized: an outside controller that measures the constraint capacities and supplies the internal production law as state feedback yields the same trajectory under every perturbation of state, damage and recovery included, even with every capacity observed exactly; only interventions on the production mechanisms, relative to a declared boundary, separate the two *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-050](../record/arguments.d/ARG-050.md) — An intervention that disables a production pathway inside a declared boundary, or interrupts an outside controller, locates the producer of a maintained organization, because the pathway causes the capacities with a delay and can be intervened on surgically, so the fat-handedness of interventions on wholes does not reach the inference *(Active, contrast)*
- [CLAIM-532](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-532.md) — Self-formation, in the sense the record holds (the transformation dimension of a will-organization), is the production by an agent's own activity on a discrepancy it cannot yet resolve of a maintained capacity, a new distinction it can make legible or a new channel by which it can act, that outlasts the discrepancy and serves a class of later ones; it is told apart from learning an action by transfer to discrepancies of the same class after the inducing conditions are gone, and from a capacity installed or upheld from outside by interventions on the processes that produce and maintain it *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-060](../record/arguments.d/ARG-060.md) — Three organizations failing one task for three different reasons show that a new distinction and a new channel of action are separate repairs, and that a new action stands in for a missing distinction only where some action is acceptable in every circumstance the organization cannot tell apart *(Proposed, contrast)*
- [CLAIM-547](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-547.md) — Cooperation within groups and the coexistence of groups are distinct targets that can trade off: in the group-selection rule of Nowak's five, b/c > 1 + n/m, cooperation spreads because a group that grows to size n splits and another group is driven extinct, so the mechanism that stabilizes cooperation inside groups works by removing groups; cooperation local to a group, the persistence of several groups whose interests are opposed, and concern for those outside one's group are three achievements, and none of them secures the next *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-052](../record/arguments.d/ARG-052.md) — Van Lange and Bergmann's model of intergroup cooperation does not establish that cooperation within groups and the coexistence of groups are distinct targets that can trade off: it shows that the processes building in-group cooperation can fuel conflict between groups, and says nothing on whether groups persist, go extinct or are owed impartial concern *(Rejected, source)*
- [CLAIM-571](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-571.md) — For a fixed architecture and one resource that must be held at each moment, the resource threshold for reaching a target configuration need not equal the resource requirement of the target: it is the least, over admissible transition paths, of the peak requirement along the path, and it is infinite when no admissible path joins the two *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-077](../record/arguments.d/ARG-077.md) — The barrier at 1.3 between two configurations that each cost 0.7 shows that the threshold for reaching a configuration need not equal its requirement *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-584](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-584.md) — Maintaining a specialized capability that is seldom or never exercised for its specialized function is wasteful *(Proposed, disclaimed)*
  - [ARG-053](../record/arguments.d/ARG-053.md) — Low observed exercise of a specialized capability is evidence that its maintenance expenditure is wasteful *(Rejected, evidence)*
    - [CLAIM-561](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-561.md) — When early activation reduces intervention delay under uncertainty, provisionally mobilizing a specialized resource can minimize expected loss even when the resource is more likely to be canceled than used; a cancellation rate alone therefore cannot identify waste *(Active, thesis)*
- [CLAIM-588](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-588.md) — Relieving an incompatibility, redistributing an unavoidable mismatch and exploiting a mismatch dynamically are three design targets, which change respectively the compatibility complex, where residuals or loads concentrate, and stability, barriers or transition paths, and the last two can be achieved without the first *(Active, thesis)*
  - [ARG-054](../record/arguments.d/ARG-054.md) — Rocks and Mehta's prestress, placed on different bonds of a self-stress space fixed by geometry, changes which force excites a zero mode and retunes stability while the zero modes and self-stresses stay fixed, and so gives a mechanical parallel to redistributing and exploiting a mismatch without relief, though it shows the exciting force moving and not a given load *(Active, analogy)*
- [CLAIM-612](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-612.md) — Statistics conditioned on survival can be stationary and quickly reached while absorption is certain: in a finite chain whose viable states all lead to an absorbing failure, the distribution of the survivors settles on the mixing time and the survivors die out on a time longer by the ratio of the spectral gap to the hazard, so a surviving organization's stable statistics are no evidence that it persists *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-056](../record/arguments.d/ARG-056.md) — A three-state chain whose survivors settle in a few time units while all of them die out on a time a hundred times longer shows that stable statistics conditioned on survival come apart from persistence *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-613](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-613.md) — A fork can be the construction of a new organization through which a disposition that the parent's governance kept ineffective gains efficacy, and not only one of several successors of the parent *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-069](../record/arguments.d/ARG-069.md) — Hirschman's exit and voice, in which members denied effective voice can still exit, carries over to a fork as the construction of a new organization through which a disposition the parent kept ineffective gains efficacy *(Proposed, analogy)*
- [CLAIM-615](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-615.md) — An organized individual's identity over time is carried by the causal transmission of the relations that keep its repertoire realizable, not by its constituents or by any structure invariant across its realizations, so a structuralism about individuals has to be historical: the structure can change under maps that are not isomorphisms while the individual continues, two structurally identical copies can be two individuals, the transmitting organization may lie outside the individual, and when those relations part at a succession, different successors can continue different respects of it *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-075](../record/arguments.d/ARG-075.md) — Two separately made mechanisms of one design are isomorphic and two, and a mechanism can be stipulated to persist through a change that breaks isomorphism; the first carries over to organized individuals and the second only as consistency, so whether such an individual continues needs a criterion of continuation *(Proposed, analogy)*
- [CLAIM-616](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-616.md) — Synchronization phenomena can serve as a laboratory for the record's organizational distinctions: locking regions for compatibility, external forcing for support and dependence, the driven and suppressed oscillator for autonomy against coercion, and entrainment and phase locking for individuation transitions; a drive fixes where control lies, not whether it is legitimate *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-072](../record/arguments.d/ARG-072.md) — Synchronization phenomena, used as model systems, can separate the record's distinctions of compatibility, dependence and suppression, because a driven and suppressed oscillator and a coupled pair with a relative phase separate them by intervention, though a drive fixes where control lies and not whether it is coercive *(Proposed, analogy)*
- [CLAIM-617](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-617.md) — When a project's continuities part at a change of steward, participants' judgements of which successor continues it are causally productive of that succession: those who judge one successor illegitimate move their work to another, and the move transfers the productive organization the judgement was about *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-067](../record/arguments.d/ARG-067.md) — Contested open-source successions, in which participants who judged a new steward illegitimate moved their work to another successor, are evidence that the participants' verdicts help make the succession *(Proposed, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-618](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-618.md) — Indexed by a system's control parameters, the compatibility complex of its synchronization demands gives each set of demands a region where they can be met together; an Arnold tongue is a locking region, where a demand is met by an attracting state, and each locking region lies inside the compatibility region of the same demands without needing to equal it *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-061](../record/arguments.d/ARG-061.md) — The inclusion of a locking region in the compatibility region of the same demands follows from the phase-oscillator setting once a demand is an acceptance set of phase differences and the admissible configurations are the locked ones *(Proposed, formal-application)*
- [CLAIM-619](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-619.md) — An organization can be disposed to answer a credible challenge by reducing the capacity for future challenge, classifying the challenge as the problem and restricting the challenger, so that the later absence of challenges reads as success; the test is whether a credible challenge causally lowers the chance of effective future challenge against a control, and the test alone does not say whether the response finks the disposition to be corrected, masks it, or changes only the challengers' access and incentives *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-059](../record/arguments.d/ARG-059.md) — A label that produces the conduct confirming it carries over to a response to challenge that produces the absence of challenge confirming it, though one loop runs through the labelled person's conduct and the other through the challenger's access *(Proposed, analogy)*
  - [ARG-070](../record/arguments.d/ARG-070.md) — Pohlhaus's willful hermeneutical ignorance, unread here, is offered as what normative inversion resembles, and the record cannot yet check the resemblance *(Deferred, source)*
- [CLAIM-623](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-623.md) — Forgetting a hidden mechanism can turn a sheaf of histories into a presheaf of realizable observations that is not a sheaf: when the union of two overlapping intervals is itself an observable context, two observed histories can each be realizable and agree on their overlap with no realization of their union, so a gluing failure need not show a disagreement on an overlap or a cycle of three contexts *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-074](../record/arguments.d/ARG-074.md) — A hidden mode fixed for a run, whose observations over two overlapping periods agree on the overlap and do not paste into a realizable history, shows that a presheaf of realizable observations can fail to glue *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-624](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-624.md) — The wrong beyond violation that an organization commits by reproducing representations and allocations of authority that keep a justified standard from constraining it is a breach of a second-order duty of answerability: to maintain feasible means for relevant violations to become knowable, contestable and correctable; it is a verdict only given an independently justified standard and a feasible alternative *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-055](../record/arguments.d/ARG-055.md) — A matched-harm construction, in which two institutions under a stipulated duty to maintain independent review cause the same harm and reach the same remedy but differ in keeping that duty and in reproducing its breach, shows that a second-order wrong of answerability can come apart from the first-order harm and its continuation *(Proposed, existence)*
  - [ARG-058](../record/arguments.d/ARG-058.md) — If the second-order duty of answerability were unconditional it would entail that a self-maintaining organization ought to preserve its corrigibility, which the record disclaims, so the duty must be bounded by obligation, capability and reasonable alternatives *(Proposed, reductio)*
  - [ARG-062](../record/arguments.d/ARG-062.md) — The Challenger-to-Columbia history is evidence that an organization can reproduce the conditions that keep a known hazard from constraining it, reforms undone included, though it says nothing of a second-order wrong *(Proposed, evidence)*
  - [ARG-063](../record/arguments.d/ARG-063.md) — A two-regime reporting construction shows that a harmful outcome and the regime that keeps it unrecorded can sustain each other without intent, separating actual from recorded violation, and shows nothing normative *(Proposed, existence)*
  - [ARG-064](../record/arguments.d/ARG-064.md) — A self-maintaining protective regime, whose interventions shift the evidence and authority that judge it, carries over to a harm-producing organization once a normative predicate replaces the evidence of continued need: the reproductive mechanism transfers and the verdict does not *(Proposed, analogy)*
  - [ARG-071](../record/arguments.d/ARG-071.md) — The Wells Fargo directors' report shows occlusion by a narrow construal of harm and blocked uptake of concerns, and does not show a performance regime reproducing that representation through its own success *(Rejected, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-627](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-627.md) — Whether a contested concept's uses are compatible is partly settled by who has jurisdiction over its contexts: which contexts count as relevant to a decision and which rule governs where they overlap fix part of the cover on which its uses must glue, so a will-organization's jurisdiction and precedence act on the conditions of interpretation and not only on its outputs *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-057](../record/arguments.d/ARG-057.md) — A rule whose outcomes change when classification moves to another group, with the rule unchanged, is evidence that jurisdiction over a concept's contexts partly fixes whether its uses are compatible *(Rejected, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-646](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-646.md) — Peak-capacity thresholds do not fix cumulative transition costs: two systems can have the same threshold between every pair of configurations, and so the same hierarchy of budgeted classes, while the least cumulative cost of a transition differs between them by any factor *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-078](../record/arguments.d/ARG-078.md) — The chain and the complete graph on the same configurations show that peak-capacity thresholds do not fix cumulative transition costs *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-647](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-647.md) — Replacing the base model a specialization was learned into can impose a compatibility or transfer cost that shortens the specialization's useful life, though nothing it encodes has become false: in the trade between learning once and computing on demand, the reader's turnover is a staleness term of its own, beside the world's changing; how often the cost binds, and whether it tips the trade toward computing on demand, is empirical *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-079](../record/arguments.d/ARG-079.md) — Because a LoRA module is an additive update to one set of frozen pretrained weights, amplifying directions already in them, replacing those weights leaves the module without the base it was defined on, so its effect on the new base is not guaranteed and has to be re-established, by transfer or by retraining *(Proposed, cause-to-effect)*
  - [ARG-080](../record/arguments.d/ARG-080.md) — IP-Adapter's statement that fine-tuned image-prompt models are "not compatible with other base models" shows that a trained specialization goes stale when its base model is replaced *(Rejected, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-648](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-648.md) — On Bickhard's account the owner's debugging case has an endogenous form: a self-maintaining system that anticipates an interaction will sustain it holds an expected response profile set by its own upkeep, the absence or shortfall of the response means by its own lights that the interaction failed, and that norm and a designer's profile come apart where the system's persistence is at stake *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-083](../record/arguments.d/ARG-083.md) — Bickhard's account and the two-profile forager show that a profile set by a system's own upkeep is a norm different from a designer's, with the same silent case and different verdicts where persistence is at stake *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-649](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-649.md) — An absence of response under an inserted intervention with an expected response profile is diagnostic evidence about the mechanism under test, carried with nothing emitted: under a probabilistic response model it shifts support toward fault by its likelihood ratio, and in the limiting case of a deterministic, independently validated response guarantee it entails that the guarantee was violated *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-084](../record/arguments.d/ARG-084.md) — Under a deterministic, independently validated response guarantee, an absence of the guaranteed response to a delivered intervention entails that the guarantee was violated *(Proposed, formal-application)*
  - [ARG-085](../record/arguments.d/ARG-085.md) — From the debugger's test and a probabilistic response model to the defeasible reading: an absence under an intervention with an expected response shifts support toward fault by its likelihood ratio *(Proposed, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-650](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-650.md) — Grice's factivity test shows that a designed alarm's content can be false: its sounding means, factively, that the detector crossed its threshold, and carries "fire" only as a non-factive content, so a false alarm's error lies there; what makes "fire" the content it is supposed to carry is a separate question, answered for this designed alarm by its designer's intention and left open, between selection history and organizational maintenance, for other systems *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-081](../record/arguments.d/ARG-081.md) — Because a false alarm's error lies in a non-factive content, Grice's analysis shows that the norm that content answers to is an intention, the designer's *(Rejected, formal-application)*
  - [ARG-082](../record/arguments.d/ARG-082.md) — Grice's factivity test, applied to the steam alarm, places the false alarm's error in a non-factive content *(Proposed, formal-application)*
- [CLAIM-652](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-652.md) — An organization that weighs a harmful practice by the failures its present users report can expand the practice with no act against complaint: as the harmed leave, the recognized cost of the practice falls with their share, so the score favours more of it, and the failures it records grow more slowly than the harm it does *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-092](../record/arguments.d/ARG-092.md) — The exit-driven drift toy shows that a practice can expand under an honest count of present users' complaints, through the exit it causes alone *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-653](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-653.md) — Where a content industry reads demand from activity or revenue, the minority of heaviest users comes to set the distribution of content everyone is offered; and if heavy users habituate and seek more extreme material, the mainstream drifts toward it, which may explain why mainstream pornography channels now carry material once niche or extreme *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-089](../record/arguments.d/ARG-089.md) — The works read on 2026-11-12 support only the premise that platforms reading demand from activity shape what is produced; they do not show the heaviest users setting what everyone is offered, and they leave the escalation half unsupported *(Proposed, evidence)*
  - [ARG-095](../record/arguments.d/ARG-095.md) — The survey and audit evidence A reports supports the structural half of the heavy-user mechanism in pornography distribution only as possible, and does not support the escalation half: the associations are small, observational and self-reported, and the one longitudinal content study runs against it *(Proposed, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-654](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-654.md) — Reachability by a given process grows with the budget when the process's choices do not depend on how much budget remains and success means reaching the target within the budget; a process whose choices depend on the remaining budget can reach a target at a small budget and miss it at a larger one, though the admissible-path reachability of the same architecture grows with the budget *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-086](../record/arguments.d/ARG-086.md) — The trap construction shows that reachability by a budget-dependent process can fall as the budget rises while path reachability does not *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-656](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-656.md) — The selection that lets economically weighted demand set a product's design extends to news: where attention is the revenue, optimizing for it favours clickbait and works against investigative journalism, whose findings cannot be shown to be in demand before they exist and whose value falls largely to people who never pay for them *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-088](../record/arguments.d/ARG-088.md) — The works read on 2026-11-12 support the news claim's externality step and, narrowly, its selection for attention in wording, but not its central step that attention optimization costs investigative capacity; the readings it cited as grounds carry less than it cited them for *(Proposed, evidence)*
  - [ARG-091](../record/arguments.d/ARG-091.md) — The selection mechanism shown for loot-box economies transfers to news in its structure, demand read through an economic weight shapes supply, and does not transfer in what it weights or in what it predicts, since news is weighted by attention and an investigation's value is largely external and cannot be shown before it is found *(Proposed, analogy)*
- [CLAIM-659](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-659.md) — Microchimerism, cells of mother and offspring persisting in each other for decades and some of them taking part in the host's regulation, bears on the view that biological individuality is graded or processual: the separation that gestation begins is not completed at birth at the level of cells *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-090](../record/arguments.d/ARG-090.md) — The persistence of maternal microchimeric cells, and the dependence of offspring tolerance on one marked subset of them, are evidence that the separation of mother and offspring is incomplete at the level of cells, and not by themselves evidence that individuality is graded *(Proposed, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-660](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-660.md) — Behaviour-manipulating parasites show one organism's selected adaptations controlling another's behaviour through the host's own machinery, not goals the parasite represents and imposes: evolutionary goal-directedness and causal control come apart from intentional agency, and that an action is executed by the host's own mechanisms does not show that the host's governance of it is independent *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-087](../record/arguments.d/ARG-087.md) — The parasite cases, with manipulation stronger in mature parasite stages and in the presence of the right predator, are evidence that the hosts' behaviour is controlled by the parasites' selected adaptations; they are no evidence for or against the parasites' representing goals *(Proposed, evidence)*
  - [ARG-094](../record/arguments.d/ARG-094.md) — Pathogen-specific changes in host behaviour do not by themselves show manipulation, since sterile immune challenges produce them through the host's own sickness programmes; what does tell selected parasite adaptation from host response is dependence on the parasite's stage, which trophically transmitted helminths show *(Proposed, contrast)*
- [CLAIM-663](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-663.md) — The distinctions of the PASS@(k,T) analysis are the record's distinctions of resource-bounded realization: its capability boundary is reachability by a given process under a budget, its efficiency is reliable attainment, and its interaction depth is a resource index, so whether an intervention expands what an organization can do or only makes it more reliable is the record's question of reachable against reliably reached *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-093](../record/arguments.d/ARG-093.md) — PASS@(k,T)'s capability boundary, efficiency and interaction depth correspond to the record's reachability by a process, reliable attainment and resource index, with two differences: the paper's process is a stochastic policy that can change with its budget, and its success is judged by an oracle *(Proposed, analogy)*
- [CLAIM-666](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-666.md) — A migration of the record's grammar is faithful when it preserves the record's accountability structure, not its old graph: where the old grammar forced a relation nobody asserted, a faithful migration removes it *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-096](../record/arguments.d/ARG-096.md) — The graph that asserted an inference nobody made shows that preserving the old graph through a migration can preserve a false dependency *(Proposed, existence)*
- [CLAIM-667](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-667.md) — Governance raises the value of a modifiable schema on tasks whose inherited categories are inadequate: with review, rationale and migration, letting a collective change its schema improves justified correction more than it does without them *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-098](../record/arguments.d/ARG-098.md) — EvoOntology's gate ablation shows that governance raises the value of a modifiable schema *(Rejected, evidence)*
- [CLAIM-668](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-668.md) — A shared record can represent who contributed a proposition and what standing the record gives it, but not what any collaborator believes or that all of them know the current standing: access to the record is a precondition of coordinating on it, not evidence that they have *(Proposed, thesis)*
  - [ARG-097](../record/arguments.d/ARG-097.md) — Halpern and Moses's result on unreliable channels applies to a record read asynchronously: publishing a standing does not make it common knowledge *(Proposed, formal-application)*
